Standard practice delivers a MONITORING/INDICATION scheme via axial displacement sensors with mechanical limit switches.  
Mechanism departure: Real-time kiln shell curvature inference from existing pressure differentials across the riding ring, predicting migration before displacement occurs.  
Failure physics connection: Shell warping induces non-uniform pressure distribution at the riding ring boundary; curvature changes precede axial migration by thermal lag, enabling early intervention.
